statement_en: The sequence $x_n:=\sin(n)$ has no limit. Indeed, one can choose positive integers $n_k,m_k$ from the intervals $$I_{A,k}:=(2k\pi+\frac{\pi}{4},2k\pi+\frac{2\pi}{3}),\quad I_{B,k}:=(2k\pi+\frac{5\pi}{4},2k\pi+\frac{5\pi}{3})$$ respectively, so that $$|\sin(n_k)-\sin(m_k)|\geq \sqrt{2},\quad \forall k\in \mathbb{Z}^{+}.$$ Hence the Cauchy criterion shows that the sequence does not converge.
key_techniques: locate integers in carefully chosen intervals
callout_body: 序列$x_n:=\sin(n)$的极限不存在。因为我们总是可以在$$I_{A,k}:=(2k\pi+\frac{\pi}{4},2k\pi+\frac{2\pi}{3}),I_{B,k}:=(2k\pi+\frac{5\pi}{4},2k\pi+\frac{5\pi}{3})$$中分别找到两个不同的正整数$n_k,m_k$。相应的因为函数$\sin(x)$在这两个集合上的取值分别为区间$(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},1)$以及$(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},-1)$因此$$|\sin(n_k)-\sin(m_k)|\geq \sqrt{2},\forall k\in \mathbb{Z}^{+}$$因此柯西判别法告诉我们，序列的极限并不存在。至于为何考虑上述两个区间，其想法可以参考:[[证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的]]其中的2.2节。
